input.sourceText: In relation to our ongoing efforts to improve the consistency of the loading process, we carried out a small trial at two bays in May. Staff used a printed checklist to record the load before the gate opened. On two of the five shifts, this let staff spot a missing parcel earlier than they usually would. Staff did not record how long loading took, and the other shifts did not use a comparable reporting method. I recommend keeping the checklist for a week at the two trial bays and recording times before we consider wider use.
input.requirements: Write for colleagues outside the pilot. Keep all evidence limits and the recommendation.
